# HabitCrew

> HabitCrew is a habit tracker for iPhone and Android built for doing habits with friends. Up to 5 people can share a habit, see each other's progress, chat in a group chat for each habit, and nudge teammates who haven't completed it yet. It also supports solo habits and daily, weekly and monthly goals.

HabitCrew suits people who find it easier to stick with a habit when someone else is counting on them, such as friends training together, couples, housemates, families or small teams.

Key facts:
- Platforms: iPhone (App Store) and Android (Google Play)
- Group habits: up to 5 members per habit, including the creator
- Group Progress: each member's progress for the current day, week or month shown as a ring around their profile picture, plus a graph comparing every member over the past 12 weeks (12 days for daily habits)
- Group chat: every group habit has its own chat
- Nudges: send a teammate a reminder notification to complete the habit (friends only, once a day per person per group habit)
- Flexible goals: a target per day, week or month (e.g. 3 gym sessions a week, 2 books a month), with counts such as 8 glasses of water a day
- Solo habits can be marked private

## Download

- [App Store (iPhone)](https://apps.apple.com/au/app/habit-tracker-habitcrew/id6787154922)
- [Google Play (Android)](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=co.habitcrew.app)
